t: A solder-free Arduino starter kit with seven snap-together sensor and light modules.
steps: Buy the kit from the Arduino Store or a maker shop such as The Pi Hut.
Screw the board and the seven modules onto the base plate.
Link the modules together with the small cables in the kit.
Install the free Arduino IDE or open the Arduino web editor.
Add the Modulino library from the library manager.
Sign in to the Plug and Make guided course with an Arduino account.
Try the first course project and watch the lights respond.
meta: Open Board. From $70.39. A few stores.
